decisions.decision: The Board will discuss with Town Counsel whether there is a gap in coverage between small-scale and large-scale solar installations (raised by John Londa).
decisions.quote: the board will discuss this with town counsel to see if there is a gap in coverage.

decisions.decision: The Board will look at an agreement with the utility so that an installation no longer connected to the grid is considered to have ceased operation (abandonment question from David Prokowiew).
decisions.quote: board will look at an agreement with the utility that when it is no longer connected to the grid it will be considered to have ceased operation.

decisions.decision: The Board will inquire of Town Counsel about the security camera request raised by David Blatt.
decisions.quote: board will inquire of town counsel.

decisions.decision: Interference and vibration/harmonics language from the UNITIL interconnection document will be added to Section 4.15.4.9 Design Standards, J. Noise.
decisions.quote: will be added to "4.15.4.9. design standards, j. noise".
